destinations.title: Vector dark matter with residual-axion depletion
destinations.question: When can coherent axion oscillations produce viable cold dark-photon dark matter through a tachyonic instability while visible-sector interactions eliminate the residual axion, allowing either axion domination or subdominance before depletion?

targets: Consistency of the subsequent thermal history with cosmological constraints
regimes: Post-inflationary tachyonic production during axion oscillations
